svg.title: What a search returns, line by line
svg.desc: The output of vault-mirror search "why is the fruit going black underneath" -k 1, with each line labelled. Line one: the note and the heading inside it, Tomatoes, Problems, and how close the match is, 0.42. Line two: the file and the line, Garden/Tomatoes.md line 13. Line three: a link that opens that heading in Obsidian. Line four: the paragraph itself, in full: Blossom end rot shows up as a dark patch on the base of the fruit. It comes from uneven watering, not disease.

g.text: $ vault-mirror search "why is the fruit going black underneath" -k 1
The note, then the heading inside it
The file and the line, so your AI can open the exact place
A link that opens that heading in Obsidian
Blossom end rot shows up as a dark patch on the base of the fruit.
It comes from uneven watering, not disease.
